UPDATE t_part
            SET status            = $2,
                location          = $3,
                current_holder_id = $4,
                next_process_id   = $5,
                placed_at         = $6,
                version           = version + 1,
                updated_at        = now(),
                updated_by        = $7
            WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
